{"consolidated_memory":"SIGNATURE MISMATCH IN KEY ROTATION - FOUR SEPARATE INCIDENTS

Component: crypto/keys/rotation.py (security side)
Common Signal: verification failure against the previous key
Common Repro Steps: rotate the signing key while requests are in flight

INCIDENT 1 [2026-01-25]
Affected: staging read replica only
Root Cause: off-by-one in the slice bound
Fix: corrected the bound and added a property test
PR #4546 on branch fix/signature-mismatch-1
Outcome: p99 latency fell from 1.0 s to 954 ms

INCIDENT 2 [2026-02-14]
Affected: sessions that arrived through the OAuth provider only
Root Cause: unbounded retry loop with no backoff
Fix: capped the attempts and added exponential backoff with jitter
PR #6603 on branch fix/signature-mismatch-2
Outcome: 72 duplicate rows a day stopped being written

INCIDENT 3 [2026-03-24]
Affected: tenants with more than ten thousand distinct keys only
Root Cause: clock skew between the two hosts
Fix: switched the deadline to a monotonic clock
PR #7796 on branch fix/signature-mismatch-3
Outcome: the job finished in 84 minutes instead of 5 hours

INCIDENT 4 [2026-05-30]
Affected: clients still pinned to the v1 SDK only
Root Cause: naive datetime compared against an aware one
Fix: made every boundary timezone aware at the edge
PR #9636 on branch fix/signature-mismatch-4
Outcome: cold start dropped 86 percent, to 618 ms"}
